_note: Blips and Chitz. Gorbi, Glorp and Jerry are talked to; the Ticket Tumble machine talks through its podium. Lines adapted from STORY.md.

arrive.speaker: Morty
arrive.text: Blips and Chitz. At two in the morning. Who is even here at two in the morning?

goals.start: Win the Arcade Soda. Ask at the prize counter.
goals.play: Win 5000 tickets on the Ticket Tumble floor.
goals.prize: 5000 tickets! Cash them in with Gorbi.
goals.done: Got the soda. Walk into the portal to go home.

got.soda: GOT: ARCADE SODA. IT HEALS AND MAKES YOU FAST IN A FIGHT.

hint: SPACE: talk or play. Walk into the portal to go home.
tumbleHint: Arrows or WASD: run. Grab tickets. Get off a red ring before it blows.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Welcome to the prize counter. Try to look excited.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Is that a soda? On the top shelf? In a spotlight?

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Arcade Soda. Five thousand tickets. I don't make the prices. I just make you sad.

choices.text: Can I pay with a sandwich?
Why is a soda in a spotlight?

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: No, you can't pay in sandwich.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Some old guy came in last night. Drank eleven of them. Threw up a portal.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Management made it the top prize so nobody can do that again.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: ...That was my grandpa.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Cool. Still five thousand.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Ticket Tumble. The big glowing floor. Catch tickets, don't catch bombs. Thrilling.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Five thousand tickets. The number didn't get smaller while you were gone.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Five thousand. Huh. Nobody's ever done that.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Now I have to get the ladder.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: One Arcade Soda. Please leave.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: It's fizzing. Through the can. Is that normal?

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Nothing here is normal. That's the brand.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: No refunds. Your portal is right there. Please use it.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Kid. I haven't blinked since the second quarter of last decade.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: You going for the soda? Then listen.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Once a round, a golden ticket drops. A thousand points. And it runs.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Tickets can run?

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: In here? Everything can run. Don't chase where it is. Cut it off.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Only the gold ones matter, kid. Do it for me. Do it for my eyes.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Never. Come back when you're serious.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Gold ones, kid. Cut it off. Don't chase it.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: You won? I'm not crying. I physically can't.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Morty! I'm not lost, I'm networking. In an arcade. For aliens.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Dad? You were just in the living room. How did you even get here?

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Great question. Do aliens need lawn chairs? I'm asking for a pitch.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Don't tell your mother about the chair. It's in a better place now.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: The claw machine won't return my calls.

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: TICKET TUMBLE! 5000 tickets in 45 seconds! Tickets 100! Bombs minus 300! Gold tickets: a MYSTERY!

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Not a mystery. Glorp told me. They run.

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: BACK FOR MORE! The floor believes in you!

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: HIGH SCORE! You are legally a legend.

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: TIME! {score} tickets! So close! Or not! I can't do math!
